LUCKNOW: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath participated in the Snehbandhan programme in Lucknow on Friday to mark Raksha Bandhan , interacting with schoolgirls who conveyed their greetings to him and shared their happiness at getting an opportunity to participate in the celebrations.During the programme, schoolgirls interacted with the Chief Minister through an online platform and extended their Raksha Bandhan wishes to him. Schoolchildren tied Rakhis to Chief of Army Staff General Dhiraj Seth, highlighting the bond between citizens and the armed forces.The Army said the children's gesture carried a message of love and gratitude and highlighted the bond of trust and affection between citizens and the Army.Across the country, Raksha Bandhan was marked through family gatherings, community programmes and public events, with celebrations focusing on affection, social harmony and the traditional spirit of the festival.

Article Title: 'Took off for Kathmandu blissfully unaware': Shashi Tharoor on deadly Nepal floods
Article Text:
Tharoor said he was “blissfully unaware” of the devastation caused by a sudden flash flood in Nepal

Congress MP Shashi Tharoor on Thursday said that he was “blissfully unaware” of the devastation caused by a sudden flash flood in Nepal’s Rasuwa district when he left for Kathmandu on Wednesday."A severe, sudden flash flood struck northern Nepal’s Rasuwa district near the Tibet border, causing widespread destruction along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers. Global warming and/or an earthquake in Tibet may have caused a large chunk of a glacier to break off and fall into the valley below, experts surmise," Tharoor said in a post on X.Tharoor added that the flooding had destroyed at least 19 motorable bridges and washed away around 40 km of the Betrawati–Rasuwagadhi highway. Eight operational hydropower projects were also reported to have sustained heavy damage.Tharoor said he supported the Indian government’s immediate pledge of relief assistance to Nepal, adding that the country would need substantial help in responding to the destruction.He also expressed concern over the loss of life and those still missing, including Indians affected by the disaster."I fully support the Indian government’s immediate pledge of relief assistance.Nepal needs all the help it can get. My heart goes out to the victims and their loved ones, who include large numbers of Indian tourists, including a hundred performing the Kailash-Mansarovar Yatra. Prayers for the missing; may they be rescued soon," Tharoor said.The disaster has left at least 270 people dead and 826 missing in Nepal, while three people have died and 558 remain unaccounted for in Tibet, according to authorities.The scale of destruction has hampered rescue operations, with Nepalese officials reporting that dozens of bridges were destroyed and nearly 40 kilometres (25 miles) of roads damaged.The Nepalese Army launched helicopter operations on Thursday morning, rescuing more than 100 people from flood-affected areas, army spokesperson Brig. Gen. Raja Ram Basnet said. At least eight foreign nationals were also airlifted to Kathmandu, while army teams evacuated people trapped inside facilities associated with the Trishuli hydropower project.India is also coordinating efforts to assist its nationals stranded in the affected areas. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said five major groups, comprising around 288 Indian nationals, had been identified.“ The first group of 73 people who are working on the Trishuli-1 power project. Then, two separate groups of 37 and 49 nationals from Tamil Nadu, who traveled for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Samrat and Fly Everest Travels. There is a group of 32 Indian nationals from West Bengal who traveled with the help of Samrat Travels in Timure, which is in Rasuwa district.”“Then, a group of 61 Indian nationals from different states and then a group of 33 Indian nationals from Kerala. These are five major groups who comprise, by and large, 288 people that we are talking about,” he added.Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah and offered India’s assistance for rescue and relief operations.“India is prepared to provide Nepal with all possible types of humanitarian assistance,” PM Modi said, adding that Indian teams were coordinating rescue and relief efforts.The United Nations is also supporting the response, with agencies deploying personnel to assist local authorities. UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric warned of a “massive humanitarian need” as rescue and relief operations continued.The disaster has also renewed concerns over the Himalayan region’s exposure to extreme weather events and glacial hazards, particularly in areas where difficult terrain and damaged infrastructure can complicate emergency response.
Article Summary: A severe, sudden flash flood struck northern Nepal’s Rasuwa district near the Tibet border, causing widespread destruction along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers. The disaster has left at least 270 people dead and 826 missing in Nepal, while three people have died and 558 remain unaccounted for in Tibet. India is also coordinating efforts to assist its nationals stranded in the affected areas.

NEW DELHI: Union minister JP Nadda on Thursday met representatives of Reservation Hatao Andolan, which is protesting against caste-based reservation and demanding a complete overhaul at the national capital's Jantar Mantar.In a social media post on X, Nadda said that he met Harsh Dubey, Mrityunjay Pathak and Ran Bahadur Singh Chauhan as per the pre-determined schedule, adding that another meeting will be held soon."Following the movement that took place at Jantar Mantar on August 21, cordial discussions were held, as per the pre-determined schedule, with Shri Harsh Dubey, Shri Ran Bahadur Singh Chauhan, and Shri Mrityunjay Pathak, members of the team. In this connection, we will meet again soon," he said.However, Nadda did not give details of the meeting.Meanwhile, Harsh Dubey said that the meeting was an important step towards dialogue."Positive initiative for the welfare of all society today. Our team met with the honourable Shri JP Nadda Ji. During this time, there was a brief discussion with him regarding the demonstration that took place on August 21. This meeting is an important step towards dialogue.We will soon meet again with the honourable Nadda Ji and strive to move forward with a positive and just decision in the interest of all society," Dubey said."Our objective is not against any section, but rather to democratically and peacefully present our views for equal opportunities, a just system, and necessary reforms in the national interest. Further information and decisions regarding this will be officially communicated shortly," he added.Reservation Hatao Andolan is demanding that quotas in academics and employment should strictly be determined by income levels rather than social or caste identities. Additionally, the protesters advocated for a "one family, one reservation" policy and demanded the immediate withdrawal of the UGC's 2026 caste-equity directives.A large number of people gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on Friday to protest against caste-based reservation, following which the Delhi Police and Central Forces were deployed at the protest site to maintain law and order.Security personnel were seen present at Jantar Mantar as protesters assembled at the designated protest area. The police deployment was carried out as a precautionary measure amid the large gathering.Reservation Hatao Andolan (RHA) is an official Instagram page with 5.6 million followers. The platform rapidly gained traction by adopting the protest-mobilisation tactics of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and has now called for a physical protest against the reservation system.
Article Summary: Union minister JP Nadda on Thursday met representatives of Reservation Hatao Andolan. Protesters are protesting against caste-based reservation and demanding a complete overhaul at Jantar Mantar. Harsh Dubey, Mrityunjay Pathak and Ran Bahadur Singh Chauhan met with the minister.

Water rose 30 feet and at least 160 people were killed, while hundreds of others, including scores of Kailash Mansar-ovar pilgrims from India, remained missing after a flash flood and mudslide of unprecedented scale in Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers tore through a part of Nepal-Tibet border on Wednesday morning. It swept away settlements, hydropower units and the pilgrim route.Nepal Police put the toll at 157, while Chinese authorities reported three deaths and 265 people missing in Tibet’s Gyirong county. Nepal Police said 579 others — 466 foreigners from 28 countries and 113 Nepalis — remained untraced, including at least 133 Indians. Among the missing were at least 37 NRIs. Frighteningly, as many as 33 bodies were found 150km downstream at Chitwan, showing how far the dea-dly waters carried victims.Among the missing foreigners were 54 Americans, 34 Australians, 33 Britons, 24 Canadians, 19 Malaysians and 8 Koreans.Many were Kailash Mansarovar pilgrims, with nearly 400 of them, including the Indians, preparing to cross the Nepal-Tibet border or travelling through the region when the flood struck.Rescue personnel battled poor weather, mud, washed-out roads and high river levels even as authorities moved families from vulnerable settlements to safer locations.Nepal foreign minister Shisir Khanal told parliament that 29 police personnel and 44 soldiers remained untraced after floodwaters swept away their barracks in Rasuwa, while customs officials, hydropower workers and other employees stationed near the border were also missing. At the 20MW Langtang Khola Hydropower Project, dozens of workers are out of contact. The torrent also swept away or inundated security posts, customs facilities, banks and other establishments along the river corridor. Nepal PM Shah appealed for patience and unity as the Nepali Army, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force deployed helicopters, drones, boats and ground teams for search-and-rescue operations.Across the border, floods and mudslides severed several roads, communications and electricity around the (dry) Gyirong port, a key Nepal-Tibet crossing used by Kailash-Mansarovar pilgrims. Chinese president Xi Jinping called for “all-out efforts to search and rescue people who are missing”.The flood destroyed critical infrastructure across northern and central Nepal, with preliminary govt estimates showing at least 19 bridges and around 40 km of roads damaged or washed away; 13 hydropower projects were hit, and around 200 trucks were lost. The Nepal govt declared the worst-affected areas disaster-hit zones for the next 3 months and ordered authorities to provide free treatment to the injured.
Article Summary: Nepal Police put the toll at 157, while Chinese authorities reported three deaths and 265 people missing in Tibet’s Gyirong county. Nepal Police said 579 others — 466 foreigners from 28 countries and 113 Nepalis — remained untraced, including at least 133 Indians. Among the missing foreigners were 54 Americans, 34 Australians, 33 Britons, 24 Canadians, 19 Malaysians and 8 Koreans.

However, Vijay's move was notable because he shifted from his official chair and remained seated among the ministers.The chief minister had attended government programmes earlier in the day and arrived at the assembly for the later session.The 234-member Tamil Nadu assembly follows a conventional seating arrangement in which the chief minister occupies a designated chair near the Speaker, while ministers are seated separately in the front row.The opposition leaders sit across from the treasury benches, with their respective party members seated behind them.

NEW DELHI: Death toll in the catastrophic Nepal-Tibet flood rose to 389 by late Thursday, Nepal police said, as rescuers continued searching for hundreds swept away or cut off along the Bhote Koshi-Trishuli corridor. Three casualties are on the Tibet side, China confirmed, bringing the total number of victims to 392.Latest available National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority tally put 910 people missing or “out of contact” in Nepal, which includes MEA’s assessment of 288 Indian citizens remaining “uncontactable” as of late Thursday evening. Nepal has not released a nationality-wise breakup of those dead, leaving the number of Indian fatalities, if any, unconfirmed.Across the border in Tibet, Chinese authorities reported 558 people missing as of Thursday morning. Beijing too has not released a country-wise breakup, making it unclear how many Indians or citizens of other countries figured in the missing list. Another 200-odd Indians are stranded in Tibet.India’s 288 “uncontactable citizens” in Nepal included 73 working at Trishuli-1 hydropower project, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said.Among the others were tourists and pilgrims travelling in groups to or from Mount Kailash in Tibet, many from Tamil Nadu, West Bengal and Kerala.By 1pm Thursday, 21 tourists from Tamil Nadu had been rescued and were being brought to Kathmandu. The 200 Indians stranded on the Tibetan side have separately sought assistance from Indian authorities.Nepal Tourism Board’s list was narrower: it recorded 178 Indians missing or out of contact. The difference arose because India’s 288 figure also covered hydropower workers and other groups outside Nepal’s tourism-based count. Indians formed the largest nationality group on Nepal’s tourist list. Nepal PM Balendra Shah said 573 people were rescued through 69 air sorties Thursday, with additional military and private helicopters kept on standby.Temporary camps were providing food, water and basic supplies, while injured people were receiving free treatment.“Our top priority right now is the life of every citizen, search and rescue of the missing, treatment of the injured, and immediate relief to affected families,” Shah said. As families searched for missing relatives, Nepal Police circulated a QR code linking to its online database of unidentified and unclaimed bodies. The site crashed soon after and remained unavailable at 10pm local time. Search teams have faced severe access problems after the flood destroyed roads and bridges, knocked out power and communications and isolated settlements in the upper valley.Families gathered at hospitals and Army centres in Kathmandu and Nuwakot, checking lists of survivors, injured people and unidentified bodies as information from remote areas remained patchy.
Article Summary: Death toll in Nepal-Tibet flood rises to 389 by late Thursday, Nepal police said. Nepal has not released a nationality-wise breakup of those dead, leaving the number of Indian fatalities, if any, unconfirmed. Search teams have faced severe access problems after the flood destroyed roads and bridges, knocked out power and communications.

NEW DELHI: Tamil Nadu minister P Viswanathan on Friday dismissed calls to project TVK chief Vijay C Joseph as the INDIA bloc’s prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 Lok Sabha polls, asserting that Rahul Gandhi is the “definitive” choice.“As Congress leaders, we are very clear. Our beloved leader and leader of the opposition, Rahul Gandhi, is the INDIA bloc’s prime ministerial candidate for 2029,” Viswanathan said.His remarks came after several TVK leaders pushed for Vijay to be projected as a prime ministerial candidate for 2029 Lok Sabha polls , drawing sharp reaction from Congress.TVK leaders, including KA Sengottaiyan and D Sarathkumar, have compared Vijay with former Tamil Nadu chief ministers MGR and Jayalalithaa, claiming he would not only rule Tamil Nadu but also lead the country in the future.TVK legislator Kallanai, who organised an event marking the party’s 100 days in office, said people had immense faith in Vijay’s leadership. He expressed confidence that Vijay would eventually lead the country and hoist the national flag at the Red Fort as a representative of the Tamil people, news agency PTI reported.Meanwhile, Congress MP Karti Chidambaram said that while party workers may have deep admiration for their leader, national leadership ultimately depends on securing the numbers required to form a government.“I fully accept that they have great love, affection, expectation, and admiration for their party leadership. This is their party. What they say within their party makes no difference to the public discourse. In public discourse, what you should ask about is policy and the law. Their wishes within a party make no difference to me,” Chidambaram told reporters, according to ANI.He said every political party has its own ambitions and aspirations, but any prime ministerial aspirant must ultimately have the numbers to command a majority in the Lok Sabha.“Every party has dreams, ambitions, and desires. One cannot pass laws to stop that. Everyone expresses their own wishes and talks about their favourite leader in their party. But we know what the political reality is. There are 543 constituencies," Chidambaram said.According to the Constitution, the leader of whichever alliance wins 272 constituencies, or whichever party wins, will be the Prime Minister of India. Anyone who achieves that number can become the Prime Minister, individually or collectively. You and I both know what that political reality is,” he added.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu minister P Viswanathan dismissed calls to project TVK chief Vijay C Joseph as the INDIA bloc’s prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 Lok Sabha polls. A survivor of the ambush that killed four members of the Liangmai Naga community in Manipur's Kangpokpi district on Friday has recalled how armed attackers, dressed in full camouflage uniforms, opened fire on their vehicle in a forested area.Forty-four-year-old Gaikamang Ringkangmai, who sustained a bullet injury to his left arm, was rescued by security forces from the ambush site and admitted to Senapati district hospital.Recalling the attack, Ringkangmai said as quoted by news agency PTI, "I am from Makui village. Yesterday, there were six of us in a vehicle. We frequently travelled by that route. We were going to Senapati district when we were ambushed by militants. Four of our colleagues died on the spot, while two of us escaped."He said he was injured during the firing but managed to flee the vehicle and take shelter in nearby bushes."I received bullet injuries on my arm but jumped from the vehicle and ran to hide in the bushes," he added.Describing the attackers, Ringkangmai claimed they were positioned in pairs and wore full camouflage uniforms. "They had red ribbons tied to the top of their rifles, from which they continued firing," he added.The other person who survived the ambush has been identified as Japou MK.The attack took place around 8.30 am on Thursday in an isolated, forested stretch between Makui Ashang and Thabamba Naga villages in Kangpokpi district. According to reports, the armed attackers targeted the vehicle carrying the group, killing four people on the spot and injuring another.The deceased have been identified as Tadsongbou Ringkangmai, founder and principal of a private school; M Wijunamai; Anil Wijunamai; and Wisobou Charenamai, chairman of the Chawangkining Village Authority. All six people travelling in the vehicle belonged to the Liangmai Naga community.The killings have triggered demands for justice from the Naga community, even as authorities move to identify and apprehend those responsible.W Charenamei, younger brother of deceased Wisobou Charenamai, said the family and community were not seeking retaliation."We don’t seek any revenge against the militants. We just want the facts to be established and swift justice for our murdered brothers."Manipur chief minister Y Khemchand Singh has directed security officials to arrest those involved in the killings and initiate action against them.The United Naga Council (UNC), the apex Naga body in Manipur, has alleged that two Kuki militant outfits, the Kuki National Front (P) and Kuki Revolutionary Army (KRA), were behind the ambush.
Article Summary: Manipur ambush survivor says attackers wore camouflage uniforms. Four members of Liangmai Naga community killed in ambush in Kangpokpi district. The United Naga Council (UNC) has alleged that two Kuki militant outfits were behind the ambush.

NEW DELHI: Delhi Police have arrested a city-based couple who allegedly worked for Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) through social media since 2024, officials said on Friday.The accused have been identified as Md Sahil and his wife, Sameera.According to Delhi Police's Special Cell, which investigated the case and made the arrests, the accused couple provided logistical support to Pakistan-based handlers and procured Indian SIM cards, which were sent to Pakistan via Dubai for use by Pakistani intelligence operatives.The couple allegedly sent eight Indian SIM cards to Pakistan during 2024 and 2025 and received around Rs 30,000 in return.The probe began after the Special Cell received information about an ISI-backed Pakistani intelligence operatives network operating in the Delhi-NCR region. Forensic analysis of his phone revealed conversations with Pakistani agents. During interrogation, Sahil told investigators that he was introduced to a Pakistani agent on Instagram in 2024 through Sameera, whom he later married. The agent subsequently connected the couple with a Pakistani intelligence operative, who recruited them in exchange for financial incentives.Sahil was also tasked with recruiting people to conduct reconnaissance of cantonment areas and obtain details about Army personnel facing court-martial proceedings, according to the Special Cell.Sameera was later arrested for her role in providing Indian SIM cards to Pakistani entities. Forensic examination of both accused’s phones revealed WhatsApp conversations with their Pakistani handlers.Two mobile phones used in the operation were recovered. Investigators are now examining the network’s structure, modus operandi and links with local operatives and sleeper cells.

NEW DELHI: Responding to letters written by SC judge Sandeep Mehta complaining against Rajasthan high court acting chief justice (ACJ) Sanjeev Prakash Sharma and seeking his transfer outside the state, CJI Surya Kant Wednesday said he has sought the ACJ’s response.Justice Mehta wrote three letters in as many weeks pleading for the transfer of Justice Sharma, who is retiring Sept 26, and appointment of a regular chief justice. Justice Mehta’s complaints are being examined, CJI Surya Kant said.

Article Title: ‘Don’t need help’: Nepal declines foreign rescue teams as flood death toll nears 500
Article Text:
The Balen Shah-led govt has decided that Nepali security agencies should lead the operation

Nepal has declined offers from several countries to deploy search and rescue teams after devastating flash floods killed at least 469 people and left hundreds missing, saying its own security agencies are capable of handling the operation.The decision comes as rescue teams continue to search through mud and debris following Wednesday’s flash flood along the Bhotekoshi and Trishuli river systems near the Nepal-China border.According to The Kathmandu Post, Nepal’s foreign ministry has received multiple official and unofficial requests from countries and international organisations seeking to send their own rescue personnel. Officials, however, said the government had decided that Nepali security agencies should lead the operation.“We received similar requests from China and other countries too, but we had to turn down the request,” a foreign ministry official told The Kathmandu Post."Don't need help with rescue operation from other countries," the ministry said, as per Reuters.The decision was partly based on Nepal’s experience after the 2015 earthquake, when the arrival of numerous foreign rescue teams created coordination and management difficulties, according to the report.Instead of foreign rescue teams, Nepal wants financial assistance channelled through a single mechanism. Officials said further international support would be sought during the rehabilitation and reconstruction phases.The scale of the disaster remains immense. Nepal Police said on Friday that 469 people had died, while 1,545 people had been rescued and injured. Nearly 1,000 people remain missing, according to disaster authorities, with 28 police personnel also unaccounted for.Nepal Police has deployed 4,348 personnel for search and rescue operations. Authorities have rescued 644 people from Rasuwa, 898 from Nuwakot and three from Dhading.Foreign nationals are among those missing. The Kathmandu Post reported that 178 Indians, 65 Americans, 51 Malaysians, 53 Ukrainians, 33 Britons, 35 Australians and 25 Canadians remain unaccounted for, alongside nationals from dozens of other countries. Chinese officials have also said at least 100 Chinese nationals are out of contact.Nepal has nevertheless welcomed international financial and humanitarian assistance. The United States has pledged $500,000, while the World Health Organization has sent emergency medical supplies.The foreign ministry has also established an Emergency Control Room to coordinate information, search and rescue efforts and consular assistance for foreign nationals affected by the floods.
Article Summary: Nepal has declined offers from several countries to deploy search and rescue teams after devastating flash floods. The Balen Shah-led govt has decided that Nepali security agencies should lead the operation. Nearly 1,000 people remain missing, according to disaster authorities, with 28 police personnel also unaccounted for.

Article Title: Nepal floods death toll rises to 469 as China warns of fresh washout threat
Article Text:
Authorities are closely monitoring the lake, rainfall and downstream areas, while identifying communities that could be at risk.

The death toll from the devastating flash floods along Nepal’s border with Tibet has risen to 469, Nepal Police said on Friday, as rescue teams continue searching for people missing after a torrent of water, mud and debris swept through the region earlier this week.Massive landslides and flooding struck the mountainous border area on Wednesday, causing widespread destruction across northern Nepal and parts of Tibet. Rescue and evacuation operations have continued, with military personnel and helicopters deployed to reach affected communities and search for survivors.The disaster has also raised fears of further flooding after China issued a Level-IV emergency alert over a newly formed barrier lake near the confluence of the Chhochen Khola and Purepu Tsangpo rivers. The rivers originate in Tibet and flow into Nepal as part of the Bhote Koshi river system.China’s Ministry of Water Resources said the lake had accumulated around two million cubic metres of water by Thursday morning. Forecasts suggested inflows could reach about three million cubic metres over the following three days amid continued rainfall, raising the risk that the lake could breach and send more water downstream.Authorities are closely monitoring the lake, rainfall and downstream areas, while identifying communities that could be at risk. The potential impact includes areas around Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border.China has also deployed satellites, drones and unmanned aerial vehicles to support rescue and assessment operations. Satellite imagery is being used to assess the affected areas, while high-definition and thermal imaging equipment is helping rescue teams identify priority search zones and locate possible survivors in vegetation and mud-covered areas.The flooding was initially thought to have been triggered by an earthquake, but the US Geological Survey said the disaster was caused by a "glacial collapse". The collapse was powerful enough to register as a magnitude 5.2 event as the glacier hit the valley floor, according to USGS data.Scientists believe the collapse sent huge amounts of ice, rock and sediment into the river system, triggering catastrophic downstream flooding. Mike Searle, professor of Earth sciences at Oxford University, said the sequence may have involved a landslide blocking the river before the accumulated water burst through in a massive flood.The disaster sent a wall of mud and water through northern Nepal, destroying buildings, roads and vehicles. Severe flooding was reported along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli and Narayani rivers, while deaths were also reported on the Tibetan side of the border.Scientists are continuing to examine satellite imagery, rainfall data and evidence of possible river blockages to establish exactly how the disaster unfolded.
Article Summary: The death toll from the devastating flash floods along Nepal’s border with Tibet has risen to 469, Nepal Police said on Friday. Rescue teams continue searching for people missing after a torrent of water, mud and debris swept through the region earlier this week. The disaster has also raised fears of further flooding after China issued a Level-IV emergency alert over a newly formed barrier lake.

Article Title: Delhi model murder: Prime accused Imran arrested after encounter
Article Text:
Accused Imran involved in the murder of Muskan in Tilak Nagar, has been arrested.

‘ Planned murder ’: Suspect came to house with knife

NEW DELHI: A day after a 21-year-old woman was found murdered in west Delhi’s Tilak Nagar, police apprehended the suspect Imran, alias Aqib, after a manhunt across three states.Police said the victim, Muskan, was alone at home when she was attacked. Imran was previously involved in a 2021 case of assault and culpable homicide, cops said.An encounter broke out during the arrest operation, during which the accused sustained a gunshot injury before being successfully taken into custody. He has been shifted to a hospital and is now receiving treatment.Imran used to work as a trainer at the gym where Muskan also worked out. They had known each other for 1.5 years, a senior cop said.Police said her family had approached them in July against Imran for harassing and stalking her near her home. The family didn’t lodge a formal complaint.A senior police officer said the two had known each other for around one-and-a-half years. As per police sources, Imran had become suspicious that Muskan was speaking to someone else.The investigation has revealed that Wednesday, Muskan’s sisters had gone to Chandigarh, while her mother had stepped out to buy groceries when Imran arrived at the house.He entered around 5:40 pm, apparently in a friendly manner as he was known to Muskan. An argument subsequently broke out between the two, following which he allegedly attacked her with a knife. Muskan sustained three stab wounds to her abdomen. She was also strangled.Police said Imran remained inside the house for around 25 minutes after the attack and left around 6:05 pm. He allegedly took Muskan’s mobile phone with him while fleeing. The phone was later recovered by police from the roadside during the investigation.The family’s domestic help later entered the house and found Muskan lying in a pool of blood. She attempted to stop the bleeding by placing clothes over her wounds before rushing her to hospital. Muskan’s friend Aman said he received a call from her sister informing him that she had been stabbed. “I immediately reached her home, but she had already been taken to the hospital,” he said.Police sources said that the murder was pre-planned, as Imran had brought a knife with him to the house. Police have also obtained CCTV footage showing Imran moving hurriedly after the incident. Investigators are examining his movements before and after the murder to establish his whereabouts.During the investigation, police found Imran was heavily dependent on drugs. Following Muskan’s family’s complaint, he was sent to a drug de-addiction centre for some time in July. Her family alleged that the harassment continued for several months and Imran often followed her. While police claimed that the two had been in a relationship, Muskan’s family denied it.Investigators are also probing a meeting between Imran and Muskan at a hotel on Aug 20, days before the murder. Police are examining the circumstances of the meeting and other details that could shed light on what transpired between the two in the days leading up to the killing.According to an employee at the gym where Imran worked out, Muskan and Imran used to visit the same gym.The employee said Imran was removed around two months ago after he attempted suicide at his rented accommodation.The employee added that he had been working at the gym for the past four to five months, while Muskan had been coming there for around three to four months to work out.
Article Summary: 21-year-old woman was found murdered in west Delhi’s Tilak Nagar. Police apprehended the suspect Imran, alias Aqib, after a manhunt across three states. Imran was previously involved in a 2021 case of assault and culpable homicide.

Article Title: 18 rounds, 5 bullets: How Haryanvi singer Ankit Balyan who sang ‘Court Mein Goli Marenge’ was gunned down outside gym
Article Text:
Haryanvi singer Ankit Balyan was shot dead outside a gym in Shamli district.

Poll Vote & Share your view What do you think is most important for improving public safety? Stronger police presence Faster action against criminals Better surveillance and security systems 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion





LUCKNOW: Haryanvi singer and YouTuber Ankit Balyan, 32, was shot dead in a point-blank attack outside a gym in Shamli district on Wednesday evening, with preliminary information indicating that around 18 rounds were fired at him.The incident took place around 7 pm near Aryapuri Nala Patri in the City Kotwali area. Police said the attackers arrived on two motorcycles and opened fire as Balyan stepped out of the gym and headed towards his Scorpio SUV.Also read: Delhi model dies after being stabbed multiple times in abdomen According to police and eyewitness accounts, four assailants were allegedly waiting outside the gym. Balyan reportedly tried to shield himself by moving towards the co-driver's side of the SUV as a wall obstructed the driver's side.The attackers allegedly pulled open the vehicle door and fired repeatedly at close range. Five bullets reportedly struck Balyan in the head and abdomen, while three hit the front windshield of his SUV.Balyan was rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival. The attackers fled the scene, and police teams reached the spot soon after.Additional director general of police, Meerut Zone, Bhanu Bhaskar, reached Shamli along with senior officers to oversee the investigation.Superintendent of Police M P Singh said teams had been formed to identify and arrest the assailants.Police are examining CCTV footage from the gym and surrounding areas to identify the attackers and establish the sequence of events. Officials are also looking into a possible link to Haryana and investigating the motive behind the killing.The murder triggered protests by Balyan's family members, supporters and villagers. Protesters blocked the Delhi-Muzaffarnagar Road, around 50 metres from the shooting site, demanding immediate arrests and strict action against the accused.The situation became emotional after Balyan's body was brought to the road. His mother was seen holding her son's head in her lap and pleading with people not to disturb him, saying, "Don't speak, my son is sleeping."Balyan, a resident of Bantikheda village in Shamli, had more than 3.66 lakh YouTube subscribers and was known for his Haryanvi songs and performances. His videos often featured SUVs and firearms. He was also known for the song "Bhari Court Mein Goli Marenge Meri Jaan."He had attracted attention during a roadshow in Shamli in 2023, following which an FIR was registered against him and several supporters for alleged violations. There was also speculation that he was preparing to enter district panchayat politics, although police and his associates had not officially confirmed whether this was linked to the killing.Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav condemned the murder, alleging that the law-and-order situation in Uttar Pradesh had been reduced to "zero". He also demanded that the possibility of political rivalry be investigated.Yadav described reports of Balyan's mother mourning with her son's body in her lap as "heart-wrenching" and said members of the Jat community were demanding the immediate arrest of the attackers.Police said no arrests had been made till late Wednesday night and that the investigation was underway.
Article Summary: Haryanvi singer and YouTuber Ankit Balyan, 32, was shot dead in a point-blank attack. The incident took place outside a gym in Shamli district on Wednesday evening. Police said the attackers arrived on two motorcycles and opened fire.

Article Title: Delhi model, 21, dies after being stabbed multiple times in abdomen inside home; heavy police deployed
Article Text:
The woman, identified as Muskan, a student and a model was alone at home when she was allegedly attacked. (Imran (L)

Suspect flees after killing

Police examine CCTV, phone

Heavy police deployment in area

Poll Vote & Share your view What is the most important step to prevent stalking and violence? Stronger action against stalking Better public safety awareness 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion





NEW DELHI: A 21-year-old woman was found stabbed to death inside her home in west Delhi's Tilak Nagar on Wednesday evening, police said.The woman, identified as Muskan, a student and a model was alone at home when she was allegedly attacked. She suffered multiple stab wounds to her abdomen and other parts of her body.She was rushed to a hospital after police received a PCR call about the incident. Doctors declared her dead on arrival.Police have identified Imran, a gym trainer, as the main suspect. He fled after the incident, prompting multiple police teams to launch a search for him.The woman and the suspect had known each other for around one-and-a-half years, according to police.Relatives and neighbours told investigators that they had often seen the gym trainer in the area. They also said he had allegedly been pursuing Muskan, who was suspected to have rejected him."A woman, around 21 years of age, was stabbed to death when she was alone at her residence. CCTV footage is being examined and police investigation is under way," a senior police officer said.Investigators are examining CCTV footage from the area and scanning the woman's phone for possible leads.Police have also raided the gym where the suspect worked and his home. His family members and friends have been questioned as part of the investigation.The woman's parents appeared to be unaware of her friendship with the gym trainer, an officer said.Her body has been preserved in a mortuary and a postmortem examination is scheduled for Thursday morning.Tension was reported in the locality after the killing, with police deployment stepped up in the area.Police said the woman and the suspect belong to different faiths. Officials are maintaining a presence in the locality as the investigation continues.The motive behind the killing has not yet been officially established. Multiple teams are searching for the suspect.
Article Summary: A 21-year-old woman was found stabbed to death inside her home in west Delhi. Police have identified Imran, a gym trainer, as the main suspect. He fled after the incident, prompting multiple police teams to launch a search for him.

Article Title: 3 Telugu students en route to work killed in US crash; kin urge govt to help bring back remains
Article Text:
N Rahul, one of the three persons killed in the Florida accident

Dreams cut short

Poll Vote & Share your view What measures should be taken to ensure international student safety? Better safety awareness Stronger emergency support 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion





HYDERABAD: Three students from the Telugu states, including one from Nizamabad, were killed in a road accident in Florida after their car rammed into a tree.The three were reportedly on their way to their workplaces, where they worked part-time jobs, when the accident occurred on Interstate 95 in Brevard County.The driver and the front-seat passenger died on the spot, while the third student, N Rahul of Navipet in Nizamabad district, who was seated in the rear, died while undergoing treatment at hospital. Rahul’s family was informed about the accident at around 3 am on Wednesday.The other two deceased were identified as Subramanyam Chaturvedula and G Anil. However, there was no further confirmation on where they hailed from.“All we want now is my son’s mortal remains to reach us at the earliest. They are not letting anyone go near him as the investigation is still ongoing. A Telugu association is helping us in the US, but we also hope the state govt steps in and ensures that my son’s body is brought back,” said Hari Babu, Rahul’s father.According to the family, Rahul had completed his master’s degree but stayed back in South Florida as he wanted to pursue a PhD.They said he was reluctant to return to India as he felt it would be difficult for him to return to the US due to a raft of changes being made to immigration laws.“He used to call us every other day. Even on the day of his accident, he was on the phone with his mother for a while and ended the call after his friends arrived to pick him up for work. That was his last call,” Rahul’s father added.Rahul had last come home three months ago to attend his sister’s wedding, it is learnt.Subramanyam and Anil are said to have been Rahul’s roommates. While one of them is said to be from Nalgonda, the other one is also from one of the Telugu states.According to sources, there was a fourth person in the car when the accident occurred, and he is currently in police custody. The details could not be independently verified.
Article Summary: Three students from the Telugu states, including one from Nizamabad, were killed in a road accident in Florida. The three were reportedly on their way to their workplaces, where they worked part-time jobs, when the accident occurred. The driver and the front-seat passenger died on the spot, while the third student, N Rahul, died while undergoing treatment at hospital.

Article Title: "Erika was photographed over his bloody mic": Candace Owens fires another shot at Erika Kirk as Tyler Bowyer’s Lindsay Clancy post sparks outrage
Article Text:
Candace Owens (Image via Getty)

Candace Owens challenges Tyler Bowyer over Erika Kirk comparison

Erika Kirk and Lindsay Clancy controversy intensifies

Candace Owens has sharply pushed back against a post by Turning Point USA chief operating officer Tyler Bowyer, who compared the public treatment of Erika Kirk with the support shown to Massachusetts mother Lindsay Clancy during her murder trial. Owens argued that criticism of fundraising efforts for Clancy can exist alongside criticism of TPUSA’s handling of Charlie Kirk’s death, adding another tense chapter to her long-running clash with the organization.The dispute began after Bowyer used X to contrast the backlash faced by Erika Kirk with the financial support surrounding Clancy’s legal case.His post stated, “strangle your three kids while evading your mental illness: ONE MILLION DOLLARS”.He then wrote, “lose your husband & father of your children but carry an organization with millions of followers on your back that recruits & registers young Patriots: A LIFETIME OF HARASSMENT”.Owens reposted Bowyer’s comments but rejected the comparison. She pointed to the commercial and fundraising activity surrounding Erika after Charlie Kirk’s death and questioned whether TPUSA should be weighing in on Clancy’s case at all.“You guys sold 50,000 t-shirts at the “event of the century” as Erika walked out to sparklers. You raised 40 million in one night at Mar-A-Lago as Erika was photographed over his bloody mic. It’s possible to disagree with fundraisers for Lindsay Clancy and also think TPUSA should sit this one out entirely.”Her response is significant because Owens has repeatedly criticized Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA since Charlie Kirk was killed. Rather than treating the controversy as a simple argument over Clancy, Owens has continued to use public posts to challenge how TPUSA has responded to the aftermath of Charlie’s death.The comparison comes as Clancy faces three murder charges in Massachusetts over the deaths of her children, Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and Callan, 8 months. She has pleaded not guilty.The case has also raised difficult questions about mental illness and criminal responsibility. If convicted, Clancy could face life in prison without parole. A finding of not guilty because of a lack of criminal responsibility could instead result in commitment to a state mental health facility.Meanwhile, Owens has continued questioning Erika Kirk publicly on several fronts. She has criticized Erika’s interactions with journalist Brandy Zadrozny, challenged the privacy surrounding Charlie Kirk’s burial location and raised broader questions about the events following his death.Charlie Kirk, 31, was fatally shot on September 10, 2025, during a student question-and-answer event at Utah Valley University in Orem, according to the university’s account of the shooting. Tyler Robinson has been accused in the killing.The latest exchange shows that the conflict surrounding Charlie Kirk’s legacy is far from settled. Owens’ response has shifted attention back toward the conduct of TPUSA itself, while Bowyer’s original post sought to highlight what he described as a stark difference in public sympathy. With both sides continuing to speak publicly, the controversy is likely to remain a major point of discussion among Kirk supporters and Owens’ audience.
Article Summary: Candace Owens has sharply pushed back against a post by Turning Point USA chief operating officer Tyler Bowyer. Bowyer compared the public treatment of Erika Kirk with the support shown to Massachusetts mother Lindsay Clancy during her murder trial. Owens argued that criticism of fundraising efforts for Clancy can exist alongside criticism of TPUSA’s handling of Charlie Kirk's death.

Article Title: CCTV shows BJP MLA's daughter slapping cop at Karnataka temple
Article Text:
CCTV footage shows an altercation between an MLA's daughter and a police sub-inspector.





MANDYA: CCTV footage has emerged of an altercation between a police sub-inspector and the daughter of Tumakuru Rural BJP MLA B Suresh Gowda at a temple in Srirangapatna, days after the incident was reported.The footage shows Aishwarya, the MLA's daughter, in a heated exchange with PSI Savitha B Patil at Aarti Ukkada temple on August 12. During the argument, Aishwarya is seen using her phone and attempting to make a call before allegedly slapping the police officer.Savitha then appears to hit her back, following which other people at the spot intervene and separate the two.The incident occurred around 4.30pm during Bhima Amavasya celebrations and was reportedly triggered by a dispute over entry into the temple's sanctum sanctorum.Savitha, attached to the Mandya Women's Police Station, was deployed for crowd-control duty at the temple. According to her complaint, Aishwarya arrived with others and sought to enter the sanctum without waiting in the queue. When Savitha asked her to wait for a few minutes to avoid inconvenience to devotees, Aishwarya allegedly identified herself as the MLA's daughter and questioned why she was being stopped.The argument allegedly escalated, with Aishwarya abusing and slapping the PSI and threatening to affect her career. Savitha subsequently filed a complaint at Kyathanahalli police station.Police registered an FIR against Aishwarya under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly assaulting a public servant, causing simple hurt, intentional insult and criminal intimidation.Aishwarya has also filed a counter-complaint, alleging that the police officer abused her. Police said the allegations in the counter-complaint were being examined.Speaking to reporters, MLA Suresh Gowda apologised for his daughter's conduct if she was found to have made a mistake and said anyone at fault should face action under law. He said Aishwarya had gone to the temple with two young children and had requested permission to enter briefly as waiting in the queue could have caused difficulty for them.The MLA also said his daughter should have exercised restraint as a member of a political family and called for a departmental inquiry into the incident.Gowda further opposed VIP arrangements at temples, saying devotees should be treated equally and made to follow the same queue system to avoid inconvenience to the public and reduce pressure on police personnel.
Article Summary: CCTV footage shows Aishwarya, the MLA's daughter, in a heated exchange with PSI Savitha B Patil at a temple in Srirangapatna. The incident occurred around 4.30pm during Bhima Amavasya celebrations and was reportedly triggered by a dispute over entry into the temple's sanctum sanctorum.

Article Title: Dera chief Ram Rahim walks out of jail again, gets 21-day furlough in 17th temporary release
Article Text:
Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh has received another 21-day parole from jail.





ROHTAK: Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh walked out of Rohtak's high-security Sunaria jail early on Tuesday after being granted a 21-day furlough, marking his 17th temporary release from prison since his conviction in 2017.Ram Rahim, who is serving sentences in separate cases of rape and murder, left the jail at around 6.00am amid security arrangements. As per the information he has left for Sirsa based Dera headquarters. The latest furlough comes less than two months after he returned to Sunaria jail on June 26 on completion of a 30-day parole.The Ram Rahim was lodged in Sunaria jail in August 2017 after being convicted in the rape case involving two female devotees .He was subsequently convicted in other cases, including the murder of Sirsa-based journalist Ram Chander Chhatrapati.With Tuesday's release, Ram Rahim has now been granted parole or furlough on 17 occasions during his imprisonment. His repeated temporary releases have frequently triggered questions and criticism, particularly over the frequency of the relief granted to a convict serving sentences in serious criminal cases.Earlier this year, Ram Rahim was granted 40 days of parole in January. He was again released on a 30-day parole in May and returned to the Rohtak jail on June 26 after completing the period of his temporary release.The latest 21-day furlough once again brings the controversial Dera chief out of jail.His release is also being linked with Punjab politics which would witness assembly elections next year in February.
Article Summary: Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh has been granted a 21-day furlough from Rohtak's high-security Sunaria jail. The release marks his 17th temporary release from prison since his conviction in 2017. He is serving sentences in separate cases of rape and murder.

Article Title: Tipu Sultan cutout video with Pakistan reference sparks row in Karnataka, 23-year-old arrested
Article Text:
This video featured a Tipu Sultan cutout with a song referencing Pakistan





CHIKKAMAGALURU: Chikkamagaluru Police arrested a 23-year-old man on Tuesday for allegedly circulating a video featuring a Tipu Sultan cutout with a song containing references to “Pakistan” and “Mujahid”, prompting heightened security in the district, police said.Superintendent of Police Jitendra Kumar Dayama clarified that the action was not related to the installation of the Tipu Sultan cutout itself.He said a similar cutout had been installed at Tipunagara at the same location, around the same time and with the same dimensions in previous years.According to Dayama, police had earlier told organisers they could continue with arrangements followed over the past five to 10 years, but would not permit any new cutouts or decorations.The issue surfaced around 5pm to 5.30pm when the cutout was used as the backdrop in a video and a song containing a word referring to “Pakistan” and “Mujahid” was added, the SP said.The video was later circulated through multiple social media accounts and came to the police’s attention, ANI reported.Police registered an FIR under Sections 196 and 299 and traced the account that first circulated the video, following which the 23-year-old local resident of Tipunagara was arrested and is being produced before a magistrate, Dayama said.He allegedly shared the video as his WhatsApp status, sent direct messages to some Instagram accounts and other individuals, and uploaded a reel on his Instagram account, police said.Police are also probing the role of others who may have viewed, shared or recirculated the content."We are still in the process of ascertaining their role. If someone else also with intention did the same, then we will definitely arrest them and produce them," Dayama said.The SP said police were also trying to identify the person who originally created the video. A request has been sent to Meta for the relevant IP address as part of efforts to trace the original account.Dayama said the situation in Chikkamagaluru remained peaceful and police had spoken to community leaders. He said action would be taken against anyone attempting to create disturbances.Police social media monitoring teams at both the district and police station levels were also closely monitoring the situation, he said.More than 300 Home Guards, four Karnataka State Reserve Police (KSRP) platoons and local police personnel have been deployed for security, Dayama said. The forces will continue to monitor the situation during the function and the upcoming procession."Everything is peaceful, everything is calm, and this function will go on," Dayama said.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Chikkamagaluru Police arrest a 23-year-old man for allegedly circulating a video featuring a Tipu Sultan cutout. The video featured a song containing references to “Pakistan” and “Mujahid’ The action was not related to the installation of the cutout itself.

Article Title: Hair stylist killed as MUV rams scooter at Bengaluru signal
Article Text:
Victim identified as 33-year-old-hair stylist, Naveen





BENGALURU: A 33-year-old hairstylist died on the spot after a rashly driven car rammed into his two-wheeler on Kaggadasapura Main Road on Monday.CCTV footage of the accident showed the MUV driver ramming into victim Naveen’s gearless scooter, which was stopped at the Vijnananagar signal, throwing him into the air and killing him instantly.Police arrested the accused driver, identified as 63-year-old K Ramanan, a retired techie.Ramanan told police that he lost control of the vehicle out of anxiety and caused the accident.
Article Summary: A 33-year-old hairstylist died on the spot after a rashly driven car rammed into his two-wheeler on Kaggadasapura Main Road on Monday. Police arrested the accused driver, identified as 63- year-old K Ramanan, a retired techie.

Article Title: Ghaziabad robbery: 2 held after gunfight, Rs 5 lakh of looted Rs 25 lakh recovered
Article Text:
Ghaziabad police apprehended two individuals following a gunfight on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway





GHAZIABAD: Ghaziabad police arrested two people for allegedly robbing Rs 25 lakh from a Meerut-based businessman on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway under the jurisdiction of Wave City police station.The arrests were made after a gunfight in which both accused received bullet wounds in their legs.According to police, the accused were identified as Saddam (20), a resident of Arthala, Sahibabad of Ghaziabad and Aasif (38), a resident of Meerut.A businessman carrying Rs 25 lakh in a bag was stopped right in the middle of Delhi-Meerut Expressway by armed men who blocked his Thar with two cars, held a pistol to his head and fled with the cashThe robbery took place around 7pm on Friday, when traffic continued to pass around the vehicle, oblivious to the crime the gang carried out inside the Thar.Gillaman, a Meerut businessman who owns a factory recycling waste material, was driving to Jafrabad in Delhi with his cousin Samad and relative Saleem to pay for supplies. He left Meerut around 5pm and reached Dasna in a couple of hours, when he was stopped on the expressway.Police registered an FIR against unknown persons under the section of 309 (4) (robbery) of BNS in Wave City police station.Priyashri Pal, ACP of Wave City said that on Tuesday early hours, the SWAT team and Crime Branch received information from an informer that the accused wanted in Case of a robbery of Rs 25 lakhs with Meerut based businessman on Delhi-Meerut Expressway, were roaming in the area on a Splendor motorcycle.On the information, the SWAT team, Crime Branch, SWAT team Nagar Zone, and Police Station Wave City police team started checking in the Wave City area.“During checking, 02 persons riding on one Splendor motorcycle without number plate were seen coming. When the police team tried to stop them, both motorcycle-borne persons, seeing the police checking and being surrounded by the police team, turned the motorcycle around and started fleeing back. When the police team chased them, they abandoned the motorcycle and started firing at the police team with the intention to kill. In retaliatory action, in the police encounter, both fleeing persons were injured after being shot in the leg and fell down. They were immediately sent to the hospital for treatment and their condition is stable,” she said.From the possession of the accused, the looted Rs 05 lakh was recovered along with 02 illegal country-made pistols of 0.315 bore, 04 live cartridges, 04 empty cartridges and a Splendor motorcycle without number plate were recovered.
Article Summary: A businessman carrying Rs 25 lakh in a bag was stopped right in the middle of Delhi-Meerut Expressway by armed men who blocked his Thar with two cars. The robbery took place around 7pm on Friday, when traffic continued to pass around the vehicle, oblivious to the crime.

Article Title: CM Suvendu Adhikari orders probe into Jadavpur University ‘anti-national’ graffiti
Article Text:
‘Anti-national’ graffiti on the Jadavpur University campus; CM Suvendu Adhikari





KOLKATA: CM Suvendu Adhikari on Monday ordered a probe into ‘anti-national’ graffiti on the Jadavpur University campus, telling the VC and the principal secretary of the higher education dept: “If the presence of such anti-national messaging and deranged psychotic drawings is verified, immediate steps must be taken to remove the graffiti, fix accountability and initiate strict administrative and legal action against those responsible. ”Posting the videos on his X handle, the CM said his office “has received concerning videos and photographic representations through the CM’s Grievance Cell from conscientious students of Jadavpur University, reporting instances of objectionable, sociopathic, violent and anti-national wall graffiti and drawings inside the Arts Division Boys Hostel premises,” adding, “Under no circumstances will campus premises be permitted to be used as platforms for spreading deranged propaganda and anti-India sentiment. ”The CM stated, “The Bengal govt strictly follows zero tolerance policy towards anti-national activities anywhere in the state, especially on campuses. The concerned dept and university administration must ensure stringent compliance and the preservation of academic integrity.”He added, “West Bengal’s educational institutions must remain centres of merit and discipline, not grounds for divisive rhetoric and unsocial activities.”
Article Summary: CM Suvendu Adhikari ordered a probe into ‘anti-national’ graffiti on the Jadavpur University campus. He told the VC and the principal secretary of the higher education dept: “If the presence of such anti-national messaging and deranged psychotic drawings is verified, immediate steps must be taken”

Article Title: Ladakh protests: Sonam Wangchuk leads Leh candle march, seeks inquiry report into 2025 violence
Article Text:
Activist Sonam Wangchuk led a candle march in Leh to remember last year's violent clashes





LEH: Activist Sonam Wangchuk on Monday led a candle march in Leh as part of a month-long programme to remember those who died in the violent clashes in Ladakh last year, while demanding the release of the inquiry commission’s report into the September 2025 violence this month.Wangchuk said August 24 to September 24 would be observed to commemorate the events of September 24, 2025, when protests over statehood and inclusion of Ladakh in the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution turned violent.A BJP office was set on fire during the unrest and at least four people were killed in police action that followed.Speaking on Monday, Wangchuk said the inquiry commission’s report should be released this month, arguing that the delay was affecting public confidence. He also said a “decisive meeting” between the Leh Apex Body (LAB), Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) and the Centre was expected in the first week of September to discuss Ladakh’s demands."This entire month, from August 24 to September 24, is being observed to honour and remember the events of 24 September 2025, which was a dark day. It was a day when five of our young men were martyred, and many others were injured, left disabled, or critically wounded.We began with a small candle march; it was kept small because His Holiness the Dalai Lama is currently in Ladakh. Once he departs, we will commemorate this month with much greater intensity," Wangchuk said.Recalling last year’s protests, he said Ladakh had been seeking its demands for six years and that a hunger strike began on September 10 after delays in addressing them."Regarding the situation over the past year: Ladakh has been demanding its rights for six years, but faced with delays and reluctance, people began a hunger strike on September 10 to make their voices heard peacefully. By the 15th day, when participants had to be hospitalised in critical condition, the public became deeply distressed and angry; circumstances arose, or were perhaps engineered, that led to some violence, and there is a pressing need for an investigation into this. "Wangchuk demanded that the report of the inquiry commission, headed by a retired judge, be made public, ANI reported."We are also calling for action regarding the Inquiry Commission led by a retired judge; a full year has passed, yet no decision has been reached. This delay is eroding public confidence. We hope that the Inquiry Commission's report will be released this month. Regarding the decisions concerning Ladakh's demands, discussed on May 22, no subsequent meeting has taken place to date. We hope that a decisive meeting will take place in the first week of September, as promised; otherwise, we will have to make our voices heard much more loudly, albeit peacefully," Wangchuk said.Wangchuk, who had spearheaded the protests along with the LAB and KDA, was detained for 170 days in Jodhpur Jail following the violence and was released in March 2026.The LAB and KDA have been demanding inclusion of Ladakh in the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution. The Centre, meanwhile, has proposed that the Union Territory administration constitute an Autonomous Hill Development Council in each of Ladakh’s seven districts under a framework based on Article 371.Ladakh’s administrative map expanded from two districts to seven in April, when Sham, Nubra, Changthang, Zanskar and Drass were notified.The next round of talks with the Union Home Ministry is expected in September.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Activist Sonam Wangchuk led a candle march in Leh as part of a month-long programme to remember those who died in the violent clashes in Ladakh last year. Wangchuk said August 24 to September 24 would be observed to commemorate the events of September 24, 2025, when protests over statehood and inclusion of Ladakh in the Constitution turned violent.

Article Title: ‘We can drive them crazy’: Rahul Gandhi takes aim at PM Modi, Amit Shah
Article Text:
Rahul addressed a conclave of Rachnatmak Congress

In a statement suggesting that students’ protest and the Parliament session washout have the ruling BJP at a loss for strategy, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi said “we” will not relent till PM Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah quit power under pressure. Party chief Mallikarjun Kharge said Modi and Shah will destroy the country and not leave anything for the coming generations. Kharge said Gujarat produced visionary leaders, but now “these two” are ruining everything.Rahul said the country is witnessing a fight between “those who give orders and those who want to express themselves”, adding that the country has started expressing itself after a lot of people behaved like “cowards” against the combine of RSS-BJP for a long time.“Our job is to make India express itself and break that order,” the Congress leader said, adding “we will drive them crazy”.Rahul and Kharge addressed a conclave of Rachnatmak Congress, that seeks to create a common political strategy with non-Congress platforms of people’s struggle.Rahul said Modi is unable to sleep at night while Amit Shah, who was eulogised as Chanakya, did not come to Parliament for 20 days. “Because for the first time, they are feeling India’s expression. They realise this country will not stop expressing itself.It will break the RSS order.”“Till Modi and Shah give their resignations, they will not be able to sleep, we will keep them awake,” he said.He lashed out at the RSS as a “bunch of jokers”, and said the organisation has been reduced to being an instrument of big capital like Adani and Ambani, far from its original base of small businesses.The leader of opposition said Modi has messed up India’s national security and foreign policy, the latter because of the ignorant idea that he is making friends with the world leaders and foreign policy is about hugging them. He said Modi thought foreign leaders were his friends, and “they caught him”. He said India squandered a great opportunity presented by the Iran war to play the mediator, and the role was usurped by Pakistan.In what had the large audience from across the country in splits, Rahul illustrated Modi’s hugging by giving a bear hug to Rachnatmak Congress chief Sandeep Dikshit - who in turn asked Rahul jokingly “if he had thought he was hugging Italian PM Meloni”, and by enacting other practical jokes. He also cited a childhood anecdote of how then PM Indira Gandhi did not take seriously the US administration’s attempt to flatter her via the then First Lady.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi said ‘we’ will not relent till PM Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah quit power under pressure. Party chief Mallikarjun Kharge said Modi and Shah will destroy the country and not leave anything for the coming generations. Rahul and Kharge addressed a conclave of Rachnatmak Congress.

Article Title: F-16 fighter jet crashes in Turkey during training flight, pilot safe
Article Text: A Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jet crashed during a training flight in the northwestern province of Yalova on Wednesday, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported.According to the defence ministry, the pilot survived the crash after safely ejecting from the aircraft.In a statement posted on social media, the ministry said the aircraft went down during a routine training mission and that the pilot safely bailed out before the crash.The exact cause of the accident will be determined following a detailed investigation, the ministry added.A large number of ambulances and medical rescue teams were dispatched to the crash site following the incident, local media reported.Live footage broadcast by Turkish news channel NTV showed a fireball and thick black smoke rising from the wreckage, visible from several locations across the province.
Article Summary: A Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jet crashed during a training flight in the northwestern province of Yalova. According to the defence ministry, the pilot survived the crash after safely ejecting from the aircraft. A large number of ambulances and medical rescue teams were dispatched to the crash site.
